_how: HAND verification of step1_corpus_route_census.json (route-mismatch car STEP 1), 2026-10-02, Claude Code. Each verdict read from the label's Dosage & Administration text (opening lines + marker hits) and the title; no network, no LLM. The census route is a TEXT classifier because the corpus carries no route key (Rule 21).

false_positive: Gastrocrom (cromolyn sodium) — oral concentrate; the only hit is the negation 'NOT FOR INHALATION OR INJECTION'

MIXED_INJ_DOMINANT.note: ROBAXIN reference label = 'For Intravenous and Intramuscular Use Only'

negatives.buckets: ORAL_ONLY 15 · NONE 15 · MIXED 10 · OTHER_ROUTE 8 · MIXED_ORAL_DOMINANT 8 (+12 resolved above)
injection_labels_missed: INVEGA SUSTENNA (paliperidone palmitate) — IM injection, bucketed MIXED (mentions oral paliperidone switching)
negatives.note: NONE holds topicals/OTC plus oral labels with no route words in D&A (Cardura, GALZIN, hydralazine) — misses in the ORAL direction, not the injection direction

targeted_reads_errors.label: Nascobal (cyanocobalamin)
targeted_reads_errors.hand: NASAL spray (mentions IM/SC B12 as comparison)

targeted_reads_errors.label: Potassium Chloride (Potassium Chloride)
targeted_reads_errors.hand: INJECTION concentrate ('Dilute prior to administration' · intravenous)

targeted_reads_errors.label: COUMADIN (warfarin sodium)
targeted_reads_errors.hand: ORAL tablets (label text also discusses parenteral)

substances._rule23: Key sets assembled by substring candidates THEN hand-filtered; rejected keys listed so they are not re-added. 'Oral' availability = TFDA-licensed MONO product with an oral 劑型 (data/tfda/brand_ingredient.json) — a KEY, not a measure of how commonly it is taken.

keys.CALCIUM ACETATE: PhosLo — ORAL gelcaps (dialysis phosphate binder) · 34070 only
keys.CALCIUM CARBONATE: TUMS — ORAL OTC · no safety section

calcium.verdict: Interaction (34073-7) and Warnings (43685-7) text = INJECTION-ONLY (3 IV labels). The only oral safety text = PhosLo Contraindications (34070-3).

keys.MAGNESIUM HYDROXIDE: Milk of Magnesia ORAL · no safety

keys.POTASSIUM CHLORIDE: INJECTION concentrate (census said MIXED — hand override) · 34070/34073/43685
keys.POTASSIUM GLUCONATE: RenaKare — VETERINARY oral (cats and dogs) · no safety

rejected_keys: POTASSIUM IODIDE (thyroid blocker, a different entity)
potassium.verdict: ONLY safety text = injection; the only oral potassium key is a VETERINARY label.

iron.verdict: NOT injection-only — Auryxia (oral ferric citrate) carries oral safety text; two IV iron labels also carry full safety sets.

keys.CALCITRIOL: Vectical — TOPICAL ointment (census said ORAL_ONLY — hand override) · 34070/43685

vitamin_d.verdict: Not injection — but calcitriol's ONLY safety text is a TOPICAL label (a second route-mismatch class: topical-for-oral).

sodium_bicarbonate.verdict: ONLY safety text = injection; TFDA licenses 8 oral mono products (蘇打錠).

phosphate.verdict: No phosphate-supplement key (no POTASSIUM/SODIUM PHOSPHATE moiety). Phosphate BINDERS present: CALCIUM ACETATE, FERRIC CITRATE, LANTHANUM CARBONATE DIHYDRATE (all oral).

zinc.verdict: NOT injection-only — GALZIN (oral) carries oral safety text.

others_surfaced._how: The 67 census moieties whose every safety-bearing label is injection-like AND that TFDA licenses as an oral mono product, each hand-read; then a same-first-token cross-key check (Rule 23, partial: it does not catch INN synonyms).
injection_only_with_tfda_oral: DISODIUM CLODRONATE (VETERINARY — OSPHOS, dosed per horse)
FLUORIDE (WRONG OBJECT — Sodium Fluoride F-18 PET tracer)
SODIUM CHLORIDE (WRONG OBJECT — Adrenalin / epinephrine in NaCl)
others_surfaced.entity_note: 47 = 49 keys minus the two duplicated entities (EPHEDRINE x2, GRANISETRON x2). The magnesium and potassium injection keys are not in this list because their exact key has no TFDA oral MONO product; they are covered in 'substances'.
